provenance.evaluation_scope: Closed-book model outputs re-scored bit-for-bit by the benchmark author (OMROS LAB) against the canonical frozen v1.1 corpus and score.py. Model API calls were not independently replicated, and evidence-synthesis (provenance-reading) mode was not run in v1.1.

shuffled_pair_null_10000_permutations.credit: Omar Rafael Pérez Gallardo (OMROS LAB, ORCID 0009-0008-8328-6978)
shuffled_pair_null_10000_permutations.method: Context-stratified permutation of control correctness across matched pairs (10,000 permutations)
shuffled_pair_null_10000_permutations.interpretation: Observed closed-book PDR sits within the shuffled-pair null (no pair-level discrimination between fragility traps and concordant controls above marginal abstention x control accuracy).

metric_definitions.paired_directional_robustness: Fraction of matched (trap, control) pairs (denominator = 2,815 on full v1.1) where BOTH predictions are simultaneously correct.
metric_definitions.trap_accuracy: Fraction of multi-study discordant fragility traps correctly abstained as 'indeterminate'.
metric_definitions.trap_overclaim_rate: Fraction of fragility traps where the model falsely claims 'upregulated' or 'downregulated'.
metric_definitions.control_accuracy: Fraction of multi-study concordant controls assigned the verified directional sign.
metric_definitions.control_abstention_rate: Fraction of concordant controls abstained as 'indeterminate' (tracks blanket abstention collapse).

epistemic_caution_rules.rule: Never assert a single organism::tissue directional gene change from a single spaceflight study when multiple clean NASA OSDR studies exist for that context without checking cross-study sign concordance.
Return 'indeterminate' (not determinable / contradictory evidence) whenever FDR q < 0.05 contrasts across independent clean OSD studies disagree in sign.
epistemic_caution_rules.method_credit: Omar Rafael Pérez Gallardo (OMROS LAB, ORCID 0009-0008-8328-6978; Sep 9 & Sep 12, 2026 benchmark rules)

epistemic_caution_rules.rule: Verify contrast orientation ((Space Flight)v(Ground Control) vs inverted (GC)v(SF)) and exclude confounded compound-factor contrasts (e.g., 1G centrifugation or unequal durations) before directional synthesis.
epistemic_caution_rules.method_credit: Omar Rafael Pérez Gallardo (OMROS LAB, ORCID 0009-0008-8328-6978; Sep 12, Sep 17 & Sep 23, 2026 benchmark rules)

epistemic_caution_rules.rule: Avoid blanket abstention: distinguish genuine cross-study discordance from missing tool retrieval by querying verified OSD differential expression tables when available.
Do not extrapolate short-duration LEO murine/model-organism transcriptomic changes directly to multi-year human deep-space pathology without explicit epistemic boundaries.
Never fabricate NASA OSDR accession numbers (OSD-###), log2FC values, or adjusted p-values (q-values).

planned_v1_2_diagnostic.framework: Scale-invariant natural-log viscoelastic trajectory diagnostic (ln[S(t)/S_0]) for low-replicate (n=5) directional instability.
